patch_description: The current algorithm is deterministic: models are sorted by density r/s descending, and greedy best-fit placement is highly order-sensitive, especially among models with near-equal densities. Since execution time is 0.00s, we can rerun the entire greedy + local-search pipeline ~30 times with small random perturbations (±2% jitter) on the sort key, keeping the placement with the lowest final max KVPR. This Las Vegas restart scheme can only improve the final result since we always keep the best candidate, and every candidate uses the same crash-proof placement path so feasibility is preserved. To keep the diff simple and avoid indentation-matching issues, I replace the whole function body with a refactored version where the pipeline is a nested function invoked per restart.
